mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 3.0% consistently compresses equity discount rates, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as investors shift from fixed income to equities.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in >55% of periods when FEDFUNDS < 3.0%, or Rank IC < 0.02 over 5-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month unemployment rate increase exceeding 0.5 percentage points signals labor market deterioration, triggering risk-off flows that produce negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in >55% of triggered instances, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts and retail sales indicate broad demand contraction, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days due to reduced corporate revenue expectations.
failure_condition: Joint decline in HOUST and RSAFS fails to predict negative returns in >55% of cases, or interaction Rank IC < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production growth above 0.5% monthly signals robust manufacturing activity, supporting corporate earnings and generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in >55% of INDPRO growth >0.5% months, or Rank IC < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Quarterly GDP growth exceeding 2.0% consistently signals strong economic expansion, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days through elevated corporate profits.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in >55% of quarters with GDPC1 growth >2.0%, or Rank IC < 0.02 over 5-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: Year-over-year CPI inflation exceeding 3.0% signals accelerating price pressures, prompting anticipated Federal Reserve tightening that causes negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in >55% of CPIAUCSL YoY >3.0% periods, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent declines in payroll employment and retail sales indicate weakening labor demand and consumer spending, jointly predicting negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: Joint decline in PAYEMS and RSAFS fails to predict negative returns in >55% of cases, or interaction Rank IC < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rates above 6.0% trigger accommodative monetary policy expectations, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days as investors anticipate rate cuts.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in >55% of UNRATE >6.0% periods, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 2-year windows.
